Table 18.8 Tips to Control Fluid Intake
• Limit high-salt foods so you will have less thirst.
g
y
• Take your pills with your mealtime liquids, applesauce, or pureed fruits, 
as allowed.
• Drink from small glasses and cups.
• Drink only when you are thirsty. Reach for very cold beverages. 
Beverages that are less sweet will quench your thirst.
• Weigh yourself daily. You should not gain more than the prescribed 
number of pounds each day.
• Use sour candy or sugar-free gum to moisten your mouth. Try special 
thirst-quencher gums.
• Add some lemon juice to water or ice. The sour taste will help to quench
your thirst.
• Try swishing your mouth with very cold water or low-alcohol mouthwash
when you are thirsty. Do not swallow it!
• Brush teeth often—good mouth hygiene is essential.
• Keep lips moist with lip balm or moisturized lipstick.
